title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health, alarm count; ammo
Side-scrolling stealth: Sam Fisher works from the shadows; alarms make a mission harder or fail it
Health bar; a mission fails if Sam dies or a "do not be seen" objective is broken

rows: sneak, crouch, hang from pipes, shimmy along ledges, split jump between walls, drop on enemies

widgets.text: Knock guards out from behind instead of shooting when you can: bodies must be hidden

Avoid alarms; knock out guards from behind
Shoot out lights to create shadows; guards investigate noise and missing lights
Mission objectives can be checked in the pause menu: some appear mid-mission

Missions from the console story
Missions from the ROM's text: Police Station, Defense Ministry, Caspian Oil Refinery (oil rig), Georgian capital, an abattoir, a Georgian microwave relay, and more

SC-20K, pistol, gadgets
SC-20K rifle and pistol with limited ammo; gadgets such as sticky cameras and lock picks come with the mission

Hidden items
Mission complete screens grade your performance

Missions
Missions open in order (some require finishing two earlier ones first, e.g. "complete mission 2 and 3")
